_comment: One three-seat Spin authority requires three exact paid starting stacks, books the paid entry, retains the reserve lock through its funded draw, settles the draw, stamps the tournament contract, and returns exact reserve, journal, and escrow evidence. Every tournament seat create or revive enters below the global terminal lock; manager assignment commits seat, roster, and exact count together. Paid-seat triggers reject zero or wrong starting stacks before every caller bypass; the old per-minute stack creditor is absent from the schema.
